subject: Preservation checklist request — FinBridge latency & 5xx escalation
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@finbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: finbridge-sre@finbridge.com, Legal Ops <legal@finbridge.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T23:35:12Z
Subject: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting customers — evidence request

Kimberly,

We just saw a sustained latency spike and elevated 5xx rate affecting our EU customer traffic between 2026-02-22 23:28 and 2026-02-22 23:48 UTC (request IDs attached on our side). Customer impact: increased request timeouts and retries for payment flows.

Please preserve any and all runtime logs, per-request traces, and token-level request/response pairs for that window. We need a verified export and a chain-of-custody statement for any artifacts produced (hashes, who accessed the export, and timestamps). Legal has been cc'd.

Specific asks:
- Immediate log preservation (no TTL deletion or rotation) for 2026-02-22 23:00–24:00 UTC for EU clusters.
- Export of per-request traces and request IDs for that window (redact PII if necessary).
- Host/instance metrics (CPU/GPU/mem usage) and any throttling/batching events.
- Confirmation of retention policy and whether any auto-purge ran during the incident.

We appreciate a short ack and ETA for the export. This is time-sensitive — customers are asking for evidence.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, SRE — FinBridge
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finbridge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-22T23:58:03Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting customers — evidence request

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for including Legal. I’m escalating this internally and putting the following immediate actions in motion:

1) Legal hold: I’ve asked Legal to freeze retention policies for the EU cluster window you listed.
2) Preservation: SRE will snapshot runtime logs and export per-request traces as a sealed bundle to an internal S3 prefix.
3) Chain-of-custody: We will apply SHA256 checksums to exported artifacts and include an access log.
4) Exec notification: looping in Sean & Monica so we can provide a short exec update if necessary.

I have attached a short preservation checklist (preservation_checklist.pdf) with the exact artifacts we plan to pull. ETA for the first export: ~3 hours. If there are specific request IDs you can share, send them and we’ll prioritize those traces.

I’ll follow up with a technical export manifest once the job completes.

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-23T02:12:45Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting customers — evidence request

Kimberly / team — running the immediate extraction now and documenting artifacts. Notes below (technical):

- Affected window: 2026-02-22T23:28:00Z -> 2026-02-22T23:48:00Z (EU cluster eu-west-1).
- Log locations:
  * Runtime request traces: /var/redwood/traces/eu/*20260222*.log (rotated hourly)
  * Access logs (LB): s3://redwood-logs/lb/eu/2026/02/22/23/
  * Host metrics (prometheus snapshots): /prometheus/snapshots/eu/2026-02-22-23
  * Kernel / GPU events: /var/log/nvidia-events/
- Retention policy: standard retention is 90 days for traces, 365 days for access logs; however the rotation job runs hourly and archives to cold storage after 7 days. Legal hold will stop that archiver.
- Extraction: I started a job to copy request traces + related access logs to s3://redwood-preservations/finbridge/2026-02-22-2328-2348/.
- Manifest: generating extraction_manifest.csv with fields: artifact_path, sha256, size_bytes, extracted_by, extraction_ts. Will attach when ready.
- Redaction: we will run PII redaction on request bodies per FinBridge's spec (token-level redaction list). Redaction records will be included in the manifest.

Attachments: extraction_manifest.csv will be attached when it completes (~2 hours). For immediate triage, if FinBridge can provide the customer-visible request IDs, it will speed targeted retrieval.

-Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
